explanation: Endeavour ran aground on the Great Barrier Reef and spent about seven weeks under repair at the site of modern Cooktown. Cook's earlier task had been to watch Venus cross the Sun from Tahiti.

claims.text: James Cook, commanding HMS Endeavour, charted the east coast of Australia in 1770.
Abel Tasman was Dutch and sailed in the 1640s, Matthew Flinders charted Australia's coasts in the early 1800s, and William Dampier visited the west coast in 1688 and 1699.
Endeavour ran aground on the Great Barrier Reef in June 1770.
Endeavour was repaired for about seven weeks at the Endeavour River, the site of modern Cooktown.
Cook's first voyage was sent to observe the 1769 transit of Venus from Tahiti.
